title: Bit retrieval from nested pair encodings
statement: Let $x$, $w$, $w'$, and $r$ be finite bit strings, and let $i$ be a natural number with $i<|w'|$. In the encoding obtained by pairing $x$ with the encoding of $w$ paired with the encoding of $w'$ and $r$, the bit at position $2|x|+2|w|+4+2i$ equals the bit at position $i$ of $w'$, with positions counted from zero.
